2026-11-12 changelog read (not a probe; local claude 2.1.322): idle compaction exists in the terminal since 2.1.299: a 200K+ token conversation left idle about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires. Off switch is "idleCompaction": false in settings.json (or the Idle compaction row in /config, 2.1.302); CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS changes the 200K minimum; both need v2.1.290 or later. 2.1.314 added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop Code tab (summary used on next message if cache expired) and extended it to telemetry-off subscribers and Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateway once the one-hour cache is on; 2.1.318 fixed a reply that was not a summary. Source: CHANGELOG.md, headings 2.1.299, 2.1.302, 2.1.314, 2.1.318. Whether it is on or off in the autopilot host account was NOT checked (settings under ~/.claude not read).

2026-11-12 changelog read: 2.1.319 'Fixed claude -p --resume with a prompt losing a deferred tool call when its MCP server is missing: the run now exits 1, keeps the call and refuses later input'. A script that treats exit 0 of claude -p --resume as success sees exit 1 only in this case after 2.1.319. Same release: 'claude -p exiting 0 in auto mode when its actions were refused because no safety check was available' now exits 1 (text and JSON output); 2.1.314: claude -p exiting 0 with no output when startup failed now prints the error and exits 1. Source: CHANGELOG.md 2.1.319, 2.1.314. NOT re-tested locally.

2026-11-12 changelog read: 2.1.319 'Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes'; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND makes it wait inside the tool call; also 2.1.319 'Changed MCP tasks to work in the terminal without feature-flag fetching ... set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1 to turn them off'. Only applies to servers that return the call as a task. Source: CHANGELOG.md 2.1.319. NOT re-tested.

2026-11-12 changelog read: 2.1.311 'Fixed SubagentStop hooks running about twice a minute for each running subagent instead of once when it finishes'. 2.1.312 'Changed prompt and agent hooks to run at most 24 at a time per session, sub-agents included, plus at most 12 that have waited longer than their event's timeout; a timeout under 1 second now counts as 1 second'. The limit names prompt and agent hooks only; command hooks (all autopilot hooks) are not named. Source: CHANGELOG.md 2.1.311, 2.1.312. NOT re-tested.

2026-11-12 changelog read: 2.1.321 'Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them'. Source: CHANGELOG.md 2.1.321. Security fix; no autopilot behaviour depends on it.
fleet MCP declares no tasks capability (fleet lane, 2026-11-12), so the 2.1.319 background-task change does not apply to fleet tools.
